runs.summary: [AI-draft] [forced-demo] [TENSION] [unresolved-calibration] Mass-metallicity relation - median relations for TNG100 (23,722 gals) and SDSS (120,000 gals); TNG uses SF-weighted gas metallicity to O/H (solar-scaled). This is an AI-assembled draft: not submitted, not peer-reviewed. It was assembled from existing source-run artifacts with no fresh data run (forced-demo lineage: gated-e2e-demo, spec.force=true). The TNG-vs-SDSS comparison carries an expected-value TENSION and rests on an unresolved-calibration O/H scale; it is NOT a physical interpretation and cannot be interpreted as physical until a common calibration is established.

Reionization ionizing-photon-budget reconciliation at z~6: star-forming galaxies require f_esc=0.048 (+0.048/-0.025) to close the budget (Madau-Dickinson SFRD, log xi_ion=25.5+/-0.15, clumping C=2-5, JWST-SFRD tail), versus indirect-proxy-inferred f_esc=0.062 (+0.108/-0.039) from LzLCS O32/beta calibrations. Median delta(required-inferred)=-0.012 dex-frac (16-84%: -0.119 to +0.043); 41% of the systematic MC shows a shortfall. Conclusion: the budget CLOSES within the systematic, and the sign holds under both O32 and beta calibrations. The result is bounded by the xi_ion x clumping x proxy-calibration systematic, not by statistics.
